'''Edgelwood''' was native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. [[Prison/Legends|Prisoners]] under the command of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dedelin]] used edgelwood, rock, and mortar to construct their huts.
